system.description:
Grants the ability to lift and maneouevre things with strength beyond normal.

  • Level 1: Lift up to 250 kg (e.g., motorcycle)
  • Level 2: Lift up to 500 kg (e.g., horse)
  • Level 3: Lift up to 1 tonne (e.g., small car)
  • Level 4: Lift up to 2 tonnes (e.g., truck)
  • Level 5: Lift up to 5 tonnes (e.g., elephant)
  • Level 6: Lift up to 10 tonnes (e.g., yacht)
